Reject any browser mismatch before profile collection, run each named attempt exactly once with zero retries, and reduce every embedded raw-capsule rather than trusting copied metrics, faults, or outcome rows. Every sample must match the top-level authority exactly: isolated Edg/151.0.4129.86, revision @083e754915c9ab93da1d8f7b9c860e4520273900, JavaScript 15.1.23.7, protocol 1.3; candidates must also bind this measurement authority and preserved producer authority d32231773e4e06db4074111b49ebe2eca698d5004bd5af3fbd8d2867d765b900. For every profile and field choose a ceiling strictly above the observed three-run maximum, with fractional or +1 sentinels below the next reachable integer or 132px resource quantum for product-owned exact caps and documented rational headroom for variable heap, DOM, encoded-byte, and warm-range fields; require the paired baseline to retain all four sealed faults and multiple ceiling breaches. This Arc-local Edge authority does not re-pin the Gate-A/global browser.
